_This page is generated from src/harnesses/index.ts, so it says what the tool does._

A harness is a coding agent's command-line program. `run` and `score` use the first installed harness in this order when you do not name one with `--harness`.

| Order | Id            | Executable     | Variable that names another executable |
| ----- | ------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| 1     | `pi`          | `pi`           | `SKILL_EVALS_BIN_PI`                   |
| 2     | `claude-code` | `claude`       | `SKILL_EVALS_BIN_CLAUDE_CODE`          |
| 3     | `cursor`      | `cursor-agent` | `SKILL_EVALS_BIN_CURSOR`               |
| 4     | `opencode`    | `opencode`     | `SKILL_EVALS_BIN_OPENCODE`             |
| 5     | `codex`       | `codex`        | `SKILL_EVALS_BIN_CODEX`                |

[How each harness is started](how-they-run.md) says why the order is what it is and when to set the variable. [What was verified](verified.md) says how far each adapter is proven.
